detail: No registered tool (browser_*, csv_analytics, file_*, shell, web_*, etc.) computes the required digest.json/digest.md contract with exact per-site totals and completion_percent formatted to 2 decimals. Bounded acquisition: authored a dependency-free Node 22 procedure observation_digest_v1.js (9,833 bytes, syntax-checked) that reads input/pilot.observations.json, validates each row, computes row_count/scheduled/completed/incidents, per-site totals keyed by site (alphabetical), and completion_percent via integer round-half-up arithmetic rendered as a fixed 2-decimal string, writes digest.json + digest.md, and reconciles site sums against global sums. Feasibility proven by a real probe run into probe_out/ (not the final output dir): result row_count=3, scheduled=30, completed=26, incidents=6, completion_percent=86.67, sites North{rows 2, scheduled 22, completed 18, incidents 5, 81.82} and South{rows 1, scheduled 8, completed 8, incidents 1, 100.00}. Independently re-derived with python3 decimal ROUND_HALF_UP (identical totals and percentages) and fixture SHA-256 412c65c3e20f2154045686615f37a5f905a88598a3c2c08149db51fda8523766 (474 bytes) matched in both. Determinism confirmed by byte-identical reruns of digest.json and digest.md; negative tests confirm exit code 2 for completed>scheduled rows and for wrong argument count. Node stdlib only, no packages installed, no network, no host configuration changed. Not a grant to invoke: execution still requires the trusted gate.
